appraisal_events.evidence: maman était la première personne qui lui donnât cette douce émotion de sentir que sa vie, ses bonheurs, ses chagrins de paysanne pouvaient présenter de l'intérêt, être un motif de joie ou de tristesse pour une autre qu'elle-même
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator credits the mother with a distinctive, uniquely compassionate attentiveness toward Françoise's inner life, reinforced by Françoise's own admiring remark that 'Madame sait tout.'

status_effects.explanation: She is portrayed as unusually perceptive and compassionate toward a servant, a quality the narrator highlights with quiet approval.

ambiguities: The candidate 'la grand-mère' appears only via the phrase "s'il ressemblerait à sa grand'mère," which in context refers to Françoise's own role as grandmother to her grandson, not to the narrator's grandmother; this mention was not scored as the canonical character.

'Octave' appears only as an incidental reference to whose X-rays were used as a comparison ('les rayons X... qu'on a fait venir pour Octave'); no evaluative or social content attaches to him here, so he was not scored.

'nous étions ses préférés' briefly stages the narrator (with his parents) as favored by Françoise, but this is offered as general, habitual description over multiple years rather than a single staged interaction, so le narrateur was not scored as an in-scene participant.
